synonyms.reason: The separate later synonyms dolphinfish and mahimahi name the fish in 1(b).

observation: Both astronomical tables use title, colheads/coltitle and row/item markup, which source-typography.ts treats as unstructured, so they render as one monospace <pre> line that overflows the column. The print sets ruled columns with a header row.

The compound block closes after Solar microscope. GCIDE and the print keep one block through Solar time, with the note on the major planets and both tables after Solar system, so the note and tables now parse at homograph level.
Neptune's second sign ⯉ (U+2BC9) has no glyph in the site's serif stack or the capture machine's fallback fonts, so it renders as an empty box. The character matches the print.

"See 3d Sore" links to the top of Sore, not its third homograph. The parser reads an ordinal only after "under"; the corpus has 1,056 "Nth <er>X</er>" references, so homograph numbering against the print needs checking before a parser rule links them.

"See 2d Smack, n." lands on the first noun (#1) instead of the second homograph. The parser reads an ordinal only after "under", and the noun label then picks the first noun; this is the ordinal rule filed for Soar's "3d Sore".

The noun's three 1913 supplement senses are numbered 22, 23, 23, as in GCIDE, so the second 23 (Marine Insurance) gets no id. GCIDE also comments out a sense 21 (a slip dock). The 1895 print stops at sense 20, so it cannot settle the numbering.
